narr: A weak warm frontal passage aided convective downpours in a weak steering environment.
ev: Flooding of Wilson Hollow Road, both bridge and roadway being covered.
Streets flooded near the intersection of Clinton Hwy and Callahan Drive, and near the intersection of Keck Rd and Lacy Rd.

Several roadways were flooded, including the intersections of North Central Street and Coram Street, Central Avenue Pike and Cedar Lane, and Millertown Pike near Loves Creek Road. Some almost impassable.
Flooding along Bridalwood Drive and Maxwell Street, with water in yards up near homes. Flooding also near the intersection of Tazewell Pike and Anderson Rd.
Flooding near the intersection of Beelertown Road and West Beaver Creek Drive.
Roadway flooded at Washington Pike and Luttrell Road.
